semble.prompt_provenance: Public queries from Semble benchmarks/annotations at the pinned dataset revision.
semble.label_provenance: Primary relevance labels from Semble annotations. Semble documents that Claude Sonnet 4.6 generated queries and relevance labels and also judged label quality.
limitations: Secondary and find-related labels are not promoted to primary relevant files.
File-only labels measure file recall but do not provide line-anchor recall.
The source benchmark compares against grep plus matched-file reads, not an autonomous coding-agent trajectory.

sverklo.prompt_provenance: Public primitive queries mirrored in sverklo-bench tasks/sverklo.jsonl at the pinned dataset revision.
sverklo.label_provenance: Sverklo documents P1/P2 locations and P4 dependency sets as hand-verified. Task files are CC-BY-4.0.
limitations: P5 dead-code name sets are excluded because they do not identify source files or line coordinates.
P1 and P2 are evaluated with exact source anchors; the source benchmark allows category-specific line tolerances.
The pinned public suite is TypeScript-only and does not measure cross-language references or update freshness.
